model_answer: I changed the verify retries and ran the bench on the same seeds. With no retries, the new board passed fewer trials, because a false done was accepted. With one retry, every trial passed. The model was the same in both runs, so the change came from the harness. That is the course thesis: same model, different harness, different results. I would report the pass rate with its trial count.
prompt: Change one harness setting and tell me what it did to the pass rate, with your numbers.
rubric: Names the one setting that changed, and the value before and after
Reports the pass rate for each value, with the number of trials
Says what the result does not show: other tasks and real models
Says the model was the same, so the harness made the difference

model_answer: First I check whether anything ran the checks. If the model says the tests pass but no test ran, the claim is only a claim. I look at the trace for the tool call that ran the tests, read its result, and check that the result matches the claim. Only then do I accept the run.
prompt: A run says it is done. What do you check before you believe it?
rubric: Looks for the tool call that ran the checks, in the trace
Reads the result of that call, not the model's words
Says a done claim is only a claim until a check runs
Says a done claim is not proof until a check confirms it
